name: Mikoto
message: 「Ahahaha, sounds like Momiji really got one over on you.」
Sasaki-sensei burst out laughing after hearing my story.
After parting ways with Momiji, I was moping over my own lack of tact when Sasaki-sensei got in touch with me.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hey, Muragaki. Got a minute？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes... I'm free.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「What's wrong? You sound down.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Whatever. How's it been going since then？ Making any progress with the guidance？」

name: Iori
message: 「Not in the slightest.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Come on, pull yourself together.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, wait—just hear me out...！」
...And so, after I vented to Sasaki-sensei nonstop, she told me to swing by, which brought me here to the infirmary.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Momiji's a sly one. If you deal with her dead honestly, you're gonna end up regretting it.」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean she got one over on me？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'm sure you already know this, but Momiji is ridiculously smart.」

name: Iori
message: 「She did get near-perfect scores on her tests.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, and she uses that sharp mind of hers for scheming.」

name: Iori
message: 「Scheming？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「When you're trying to figure out Momiji's actions, first thing you do is rule out coincidence.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If her underwear was sitting right on top of her bag, it's because she decided she needed it to be there.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Momiji put her underwear on top of her things ahead of time so she could whip it out in an emergency.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「When you called out to stop her, she flashed the underwear she'd already prepped, caught you off guard, and slipped away.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, but the odds of her running into me weren't even that high.」
I'd only gone to the station front because I was chasing after Ririmu when she ran off, and I only noticed Momiji because Ririmu almost bumped into her.
Both of those were heavily driven by chance.
Was Momiji really anticipating even something like that...？

name: Mikoto
message: 「Exactly. If she spotted you, she had plenty of ways to avoid running into you—hiding, running away, whatever.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Still, the chance of ending up in a situation she couldn't escape from wasn't zero. So Momiji took out an insurance policy.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You made preparations in advance for an infinitesimally low probability.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Do you understand what that implies？」
The reason for taking out insurance against an infinitesimally low probability.
……It’s when being exposed carries an infinitesimally high risk.

name: Iori
message: 「There was something she absolutely didn't want me to see in that bag……？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Correct. That’s the logical conclusion.」
I see, I finally understand what she meant by 'you got the better of me'.

name: Iori
message: 「At that moment, should I have ignored the underwear and insisted, 'Show me the bottom of the bag'……！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That’s exactly right.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So there’s no need to blame yourself for lacking delicacy. It was all part of Momiji’s scheme. Worrying about it is just a waste of time.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, but, are you sure? Could the underwear have been a coincidence……?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I told you, didn't I? When considering Momiji’s actions, rule out coincidences.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Momiji is a strategist to the bone. Don't forget that even the anxiety you're feeling right now is part of her calculations.」
Are you serious…… Momiji is too terrifying.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, whatever. I knew Momiji would have a hard time.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「But as for Kazamine Setsugekka, Tobe Ririmu, and Kuki Asahi.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「The difficulty level shouldn't be that high for those three, should it? What on earth are you dragging your feet for?」

name: Iori
message: 「Easy for you to say, but they’re all a handful……」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Obviously. Did you forget my advice？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「This place is different from some lukewarm academy where they just teach you school subjects. This is a place that teaches you how to beat the hell out of someone with a blade.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Martial artists don’t bow their heads to someone they consider inferior to themselves. Use whatever means necessary to hammer the hierarchy into them.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Listen, Muragaki. They look down on you.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Who would ever want to be taught by someone they can easily push around？」
……Ah, I see.
Murakumo Academy is a truly narrow gate, with the entrance exam for the Martial Arts Division being over 50 times the capacity. By simple calculation, only one in fifty students gets in.
That’s why the students who make it in are possessed by a kind of elitist mindset.
I’m no exception. When I first enrolled in the academy, I was an insufferable brat.
The reason I turned over a new leaf and started taking a teacher's guidance seriously is that I was soundly beaten and left helpless by the school's special instructor.

name: Iori
message: 「……I was being looked down on, wasn't I.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That's right. Setsugekka, Momiji, Asahi, and Ririmu all look down on you.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That's why they won't obey you. It's as simple as that.」
……At first, when I received that advice from Sasaki, I couldn't believe it.
I thought that even without resorting to corporal punishment or disciplinary measures, they would surely understand if I just conveyed my passion to them.
That's what I believed.
But it seems that was just a naive fantasy. These past few days have taught me otherwise.
As I dwelled on all of this, I gradually started to get angry.
I’ve tried my best to be a good teacher, but I was about at my limit.

name: Iori
message: 「Heh… ugh, hehe, heh-heh-heh…！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha! Ha-hahaha! Hahahahaha!!!」

name: Mikoto
message: 「H-hey.」

name: Iori
message: 「Honestly… they won't listen to a word I say, they’re selfish, they cause nothing but trouble, they plot behind my back, and they run circles around me—those girls are really something else！」

name: Iori
message: 「Do they think I’m some kind of saint or something！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Even I have a breaking point, you know！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, fine! If that’s how you want to play it, then I’ve got a few ideas of my own!」

name: Iori
message: 「Kind, gentle Mr. Iori is off-duty as of this moment！」

name: Iori
message: 「Starting tomorrow, it’s the era of the drill sergeant Muragaki Iori！」

name: Iori
message: 「Prepare yourselves, you Takamura Class chicks！！」
I raised my fist high, laughing wildly.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Ah, maybe I pushed him a little too far…」
